name: Dr. Priya Raman
title: Professor of Human-Centered Design
relationship: Alex's thesis advisor at the University of Washington
quote: Alex is the rare designer who finishes the thought. Where most students stop at a handsome mockup, Alex went back to the transit stop three more times, sat with riders who could not read the board, and rebuilt the design around what he saw. He writes clearly, takes criticism as information rather than injury, and ships. I recommend him without reservation.

name: Marcus Webb
title: Director of Product, Cascade Freight
quote: Alex spent his first two weeks with us riding shifts in the terminal instead of opening Figma, and the load board he designed afterward is the only interface our dispatchers have ever asked us not to change. He is calm under a deadline and genuinely pleasant to work with.
